baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions of following what provokes divine displeasure and recoiling from divine approval lead directly into the failure of intentional works.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following supplies directional dependence, displeasure and approval form opposed poles, aversion fixes the subject against the approval pole, and the result clause makes the efficacy of deliberate action depend on that orientation.

activation_trace.role: Following as going behind a lead supplies directional dependence and makes allegiance the first causal link.
Displeasure as the contrary of acceptance supplies the negative pole toward which the followed object leads.
Aversion as active incompatibility with acceptance makes the inward refusal distinct from the outward following.
Acceptance opposed to displeasure supplies the rejected positive orientation.
Downward collapse supplies the transition from misorientation to lost efficacy.
Purposeful action identifies what collapses as intended production, not mere motion.

changed_reading.before: They made bad choices, so their good deeds were canceled.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a directional system: sustained following and cultivated aversion orient the agent away from acceptance until intentional production loses efficacy as a whole.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object rejected is not only a favorable outcome but an intensified divine acceptance, set beside worship, aversion, and the causing of displeasure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The approval branches permit abundant acceptance, mutual consent, and effort to obtain another's acceptance. With the divine name's worship relation, hating that approval can be read as refusal of a relation of responsive consent, not merely dislike of a reward.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped supply the vertical relation within which displeasure and acceptance matter.
Intensified or sought approval enlarges the rejected object beyond a momentary favorable feeling.
Reciprocal consent supplies a relational possibility that the subjects refuse to inhabit.
Seeking another's acceptance supplies the effortful side of alignment that their aversion blocks.
The second mapped inventory confirms acceptance and approval against displeasure while keeping the split mapping visible.
Repugnance toward acceptance turns relational nonparticipation into an active preference.

changed_reading.before: They disliked receiving God's reward or favor.
changed_reading.after: They recoil from the very relation of seeking and receiving divine acceptance; the failed works are products performed outside the consent relation that would make them responsive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb governing the works carries images of fatal swelling from harmful intake and of a water source going dry.
baseline_models.mechanism: A work may remain visibly present yet lose its capacity to sustain: harmful intake can produce deceptive fullness near death, while a depleted well retains its structure without its water. The result is failure of viability rather than simple nonexistence.

activation_trace.role: Fatal swelling after harmful grazing supplies a model of impressive appearance masking internal ruin.
A well whose water has gone supplies a model of retained form with lost sustaining yield.
Purposeful action is the produced structure whose viability or yield is lost.
Unbroken succession allows repeated intake or practice to accumulate into the terminal condition.

changed_reading.before: The works disappear from an account after judgment.
changed_reading.after: The works can persist as visible performances while becoming internally nonviable: swollen by corrupt intake or left as a dry productive structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier paired followers disclose that following is not condemned in itself; its object determines whether action is connected to what is stable and real or to what loses truth and standing. This sharpens the focus causality from generic wrongdoing into inherited track quality.

activation_trace.role: The focus following supplies the directional attachment whose object needs identification.
Purposeful works are the downstream products whose standing follows the chosen track.
Two acts of going behind a lead hold the motion constant while the objects are contrasted.
Loss of truth and stability characterizes one followed track and supplies a transmissible failure condition.
Stable correspondence to reality characterizes the other followed track and provides the contrastive control.

structural_cues: 47:3 places two occurrences of following in one balanced construction while changing only the followed object.
The focus result clause applies failure to works after naming the direction of following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired following of the unstable and the stable; I infer that track quality propagates into the standing of subsequent works. A live alternative is that the pair only classifies persons morally without describing transmission into action.

changed_reading.before: Following is itself the defective behavior.
changed_reading.after: Following is a neutral dependency relation whose object lends stability or instability to the works generated along its track.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier near-duplicate formula ties aversion specifically to what was delivered, while the later contrast depicts enjoyment and eating like livestock. Together with the harmful-grazing branch of failure, the focus can stage misalignment as repeated consumption that nourishes appearance but destroys capacity.

activation_trace.role: Harmful grazing that swells an animal toward death supplies the material conversion from intake to failed viability.
Intentional works become the organism-like output whose apparent growth can conceal damage.
Aversion to the delivered matter repeats the affective refusal that precedes failure in the focus.
Something made to descend and reach its recipients specifies what their aversion refuses to take in.
The repeated failure verb carries the same harmful-intake potential in the earlier causal formula.
The same purposeful products fail in the earlier echo, stabilizing the causal pattern.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the attractive short-term payoff that can disguise the damaging intake.
Literal taking of food makes consumption, rather than abstract preference alone, available as the contextual analogy.
Livestock supplies the explicit animal comparator that activates the grazing branch without turning it into a lexical gloss.

structural_cues: 47:9 repeats aversion, divine delivery, failure, and works in nearly the same causal order as the focus.
47:12 coordinates present enjoyment with repeated eating and an explicit livestock comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated failure formula and an animal-eating comparison; I supply the arrow from repeated intake to the harmful-grazing image carried by the focus verb. The live alternative is a purely juridical annulment with no metabolic analogy.

changed_reading.before: The deeds are externally canceled despite having functioned normally.
changed_reading.after: The deeds are metabolically self-defeating: their chosen intake produces deceptive fullness while consuming the conditions of durable life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear evidence is set against beautified bad work and desire-following; later, people physically listen yet leave unable to retain the communication and again follow desire. The focus aversion therefore reads as motivated filtering: appetite organizes attention so that acceptance becomes repellent and damaging work looks attractive.

activation_trace.role: Active repugnance anchors the changed reading in a shaped affect rather than a lack of information.
Tracking trace after trace supplies a model of attention repeatedly selecting confirming cues.
Manifest clarity removes simple absence of evidence as the explanation for misalignment.
The bad purposeful act is already present but can be made attractive to its agent.
Going behind a lead connects the attractive presentation to sustained behavioral direction.
Inclination of the self supplies the internal selector that competes with clear evidence.
Knowledge as disclosure contrasts with hearers who fail to carry the disclosed matter away.
Repeated following after an episode of hearing shows that exposure does not displace the prior lead.
Self-inclination again supplies the rival guide that filters what was heard.

structural_cues: 47:14 opposes manifest evidence to a bad work made attractive, then names following desire.
47:16 stages hearing without durable uptake and ends with the same desire-following sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, beautification, hearing failure, and repeated desire-following; I infer an attentional filter that converts prior inclination into aversion toward approval. An alternative is deliberate rejection after full comprehension rather than biased uptake.

changed_reading.before: They know the approved course but simply prefer another one.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated appetite-track reorganizes salience itself: damaging work is beautified, disclosure is not retained, and divine acceptance is experienced as the disliked option.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreat after guidance becomes visible is followed by a concealed promise of obedience in part to those who hate the delivered message. The focus following is thus concretized as negotiated split allegiance: selective compliance transfers authority to an aversive coalition while preserving an outward remainder.

activation_trace.role: Following anchors the coalition reading in an actual relation of going behind another lead.
Mutual consent supplies the relational allegiance displaced by the alternative compact.
Religious retreat supplies a reversal of prior alignment rather than initial ignorance.
Turning the back gives the reversal a bodily direction that anticipates following another lead.
Guidance becoming manifest makes the retreat a response after disclosure.
The addressed coalition is identified by active aversion to what was delivered.
The delivered matter specifies the contested authority around which allegiance divides.
Compliance supplies the operative transfer from private affinity to enacted allegiance.
Partition makes the obedience selective and explains how outward conformity can coexist with rival loyalty.
Command and obligation identify the contested domain in which selective compliance operates.
Concealment in the interior explains why the split can remain hidden beneath visible acts.

structural_cues: 47:25-26 move from reversal after clarity to a quoted promise of partial obedience.
The promise is directed to people characterized by the same aversion construction that appears near the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversal, disclosure, partial obedience, and concealment; I infer that the focus following names the resulting transfer of operative allegiance. A live alternative is a single tactical concession rather than a durable coalition.

changed_reading.after: They maintain split allegiance, secretly granting selected command-authority to an aversive coalition; the surviving outward works cannot remain integrated.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, inner disorder and concealed rancor are brought outward, recognizable in inflected speech and known through works; testing then makes the inner condition observable through striving, endurance, and reports. Failed works can therefore be read as failed assays: action reveals rather than successfully conceals allegiance.

activation_trace.role: A wound that relapses and leaves marks supplies a focus-anchored image of hidden disorder becoming consequential in performance.
Purposeful acts are the observable outputs through which the concealed orientation is tested.
Departure from health and balance supplies an inner condition that can distort outward function.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent condition to observable evidence.
The slant of speech toward its underlying sense makes small verbal form an index of concealed allegiance.
Disclosure to a knower frames works as evidence rather than opaque possessions.
The context directly places purposeful works under knowledge, supporting their diagnostic function.
Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the assay mechanism for persons and their reports.
The second mapped inventory independently carries examination that manifests condition, preserving the split-root evidence.
Knowledge of a report and its interior turns reported conduct into evidence about what lies beneath it.

structural_cues: 47:29 names concealed rancor at word index 11, but that root has no branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue.
47:29-31 progress from interior condition, to outward tell, to explicit testing of persons and reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden disorder, emergence, telltale speech, known works, and tests that reveal condition; I infer that failure means the works do not pass as evidence of integrated allegiance. The alternative is that testing merely precedes recompense and does not explain the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds are erased after their inner state is independently judged.
changed_reading.after: Their deeds function as assays that expose the inner split; they fail precisely as attempted evidence of a loyalty they do not embody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence repeats the failure of works for opposition, warns the addressees not to invalidate their own works, and then denies that God will deprive them of any work. This makes the focus result participatory and non-arbitrary: rival obedience can perform the invalidation, while faithful work is not underpaid.

activation_trace.role: Collapse in the focus supplies the result whose agency is clarified by the later warning.
Purposeful works remain the common object across divine causation, human warning, and promised preservation.
The messenger and message specify the relational authority against which opposition is enacted.
A second contextual collapse of works binds invalidation to continued opposition after clarity.
The repeated object confirms that intended acts, not merely plans, lose standing.
Obedient yielding supplies the positive action that protects integration with the governing relation.
The command not to remove or nullify works assigns agents a real role in their works' loss.
Purposeful action is explicitly placed under the human warning against invalidation.
Denial of a loss that strips a right or work supplies the control against arbitrary divine underpayment.
Works are explicitly guaranteed against deprivation when the relation of allegiance is maintained.

structural_cues: 47:32 repeats opposition after guidance and the failure of works.
47:33 shifts grammatical agency into a prohibition against invalidating one's own works.
47:35 denies deprivation of works, constraining the focus result against an arbitrary-loss reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated failure, a human-directed prohibition, and a promise of no deprivation; I infer that God causes the consequence through the agents' enacted disintegration rather than capricious confiscation. The alternative is a purely external judgment followed by a separate ethical warning.

changed_reading.before: God externally removes deeds that otherwise retain their value.
changed_reading.after: Selective allegiance actively invalidates the works' own coherence, and divine causation ratifies that consequence while explicitly excluding unjust deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement distinguishes wages for faithful action from a demand that exposes withholding; expenditure leaves wealth, stinginess rebounds on the self, God remains independent, and another people may replace the refusers. The focus works can therefore be read as losing remunerable relation because the agent withholds the self from the relation, not because God needs the product.

activation_trace.role: Effort to obtain another's acceptance supplies the responsive relation within which recompense can have meaning.
The wage or provision of labor makes remunerable action available within the focus noun.
Payment for work supplies an explicit positive counterpart to the focus works' loss of yield.
Pressing a demand to its limit supplies the test that brings guarded attachment into view.
Withholding supplies the behavioral refusal through which concealed aversion becomes economically visible.
Extraction from concealment turns the demand into a revealer of inward resistance.
Wealth leaving in expenditure supplies the concrete surrender the withholding subject resists.
The self as the thing itself makes the rebound of withholding reflexive rather than a loss imposed on God.
Independence from need prevents the economic mechanism from implying divine dependence on human output.
Need and limited means locate dependence on the human side of the relation.
One party standing in place of another makes refusal culminate in replacement rather than divine loss.

structural_cues: 47:36-38 move from promised wages, through a demand that exposes withholding, to self-harm and replacement.
47:37 again names concealed rancor at word index 6 without a branch inventory; it remains a structural cue only.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work-wages, expenditure, withholding, reflexive loss, divine independence, and replacement; I infer that failed works have exited a remunerable relation because the agent withholds allegiance. The alternative is that the economic sequence concerns wealth alone and does not reinterpret the focus works.

changed_reading.before: The failed works are valuable goods confiscated by an offended authority.
changed_reading.after: The works lose remunerable relation when their makers withhold themselves; the loss rebounds on the dependent agent, while the independent recipient neither needs nor gains from confiscation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading failed works as a dry well is surprising because it spatializes moral efficacy, but it remains anchored in a focus branch for the causative verb and is activated by the context's abundant flowing waters. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for lost yield, not as the verb's exclusive lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus causative verb includes the disappearance of a well's water, while its object is purposeful production.

activation_trace.role: A well left without returning water supplies the image of productive infrastructure whose yield has vanished.
Purposeful works are the productive structure reimagined as retaining form after loss of output.
Multiple watercourses cutting through land provide the contextual opposite of a depleted source.
Water appearing, entering, and increasing supplies the positive abundance against which dryness registers as failed yield.

changed_reading.before: Invalidation deletes completed acts from a ledger.
changed_reading.after: Invalidation drains the works' capacity to yield, leaving a recognizable structure as empty as a well whose water no longer returns.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This claim-and-liability reading is branch-distant because ordinary following does not require litigation, yet it is anchored in two focus branches of following and gains contrast from later wage and non-deprivation language. It should be rendered as a legal-accounting possibility, not as a replacement for directional following.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root for following can name both pursuing a claim and a consequence that attaches to a person, while works can name labor's wage.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit of a due claim converts following into a relation that can generate enforceable consequence.
An attached liability supplies the possibility that what is followed returns as a claim upon the follower.
Labor's wage makes the failed works legible as an expected credit exposed to a counterclaim.
Loss that strips a right or work supplies the later assurance that rightful credit will not be wrongfully reduced.
Recompense for labor confirms that action may carry a credit side as well as the focus model's attached liability side.

changed_reading.before: Following a wrong object merely precedes loss of reward.
changed_reading.after: Following creates an attached liability that answers the expected wage of labor; the same works offered as credit become evidence of the counterclaim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: A relapsed-wound model is odd because it allows failed works to leave marks rather than vanish, but the image is directly available in the focus failure root and coheres with the following context's diseased interior being exposed. Downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for residual trace after lost efficacy, not as a claim that invalidated deeds retain merit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus causative verb includes a wound relapsing and healing with a remaining trace.

activation_trace.role: Relapse of a wound with a remaining mark supplies failure as loss of health without erasure of history.
Purposeful actions become historical traces whose efficacy can die while their marks remain.
Departure from health activates the wound domain as a contextual model for inward moral dysfunction.
Drawing the hidden condition outward explains how an old lesion can become legible through its effects.

changed_reading.before: Failed deeds leave no meaningful trace at all.
changed_reading.after: Their efficacy is lost like health in a relapsed wound, while scars remain as disclosed history and evidence of the underlying condition.

strongest_changes: 47:3 changes following from an intrinsically bad act into a dependency whose object lends stability or instability to later works.
47:25-26 concretize the focus as concealed split allegiance expressed through promised partial obedience to an aversive coalition.
47:29-35 recast failed works as diagnostic outputs and partly self-invalidated acts, while the promise of no deprivation blocks an arbitrary-confiscation reading.
The harmful-grazing, dry-well, and relapsed-wound branches preserve live material readings in which works retain appearance or trace after losing viability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus initially looked like a compact reward-and-punishment formula, but ordered echoes turned it into several coexisting mechanisms: track dependence, relational refusal, appetite-shaped attention, secret divided obedience, evidentiary testing, self-invalidation, and failed yield. The causative failure root was especially productive because its material branches resist equating invalidation with simple deletion.
remaining_uncertainties: The ingestion, dry-well, and wound models may be illuminating material analogies rather than mechanisms intended by the local syntax.
The approval branches leave open whether relational mutuality is active here or whether only intensified divine acceptance is relevant.
The testing sequence may explain how the inner split becomes known without explaining why the focus works lose efficacy.
Partial obedience may describe a durable transfer of allegiance or only a tactical concession; both remain plausible.
